items.title: Closedness of the locus where the Picard fibre is trivial, for integral geometric fibres
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: In the Picard setup of the diagonal lemma (f flat proper with a relatively generated invertible sheaf E, Z the locus where the fibre of E is trivial), adding that E is invertible and the geometric fibres are integral makes Z closed in S. The proof is a written valuative reduction: since Z -> S is of finite presentation, closedness follows from the reach-points lemma applied to valuation rings, and the valuative condition itself follows from the triviality-over-valuation-ring lemma together with the characterization of Z in the setup lemma. Retained author proof at lines 9418-9427.
